subject: Enterprise access controls — handshake & implementation plan
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@greenwave.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Samuel Ortiz <s.ortiz@greenwave.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T13:15:00-04:00
Subject: Kickoff: enterprise access controls for Redwood onboarding

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — GreenWave is ready to move to a pilot and we need to lock down identity and network controls before the import. High-level asks from our security & IT teams: 

- SAML SSO (IdP is Okta) with Just-in-Time provisioning preferred, but we can accept SCIM if needed for groups.
- SCIM provisioning for users + team membership; we'd like group -> role mapping (engineers, security-reviewers, read-only).
- IP allowlist for admin console access (we'll provide 3 CIDR blocks).
- Service account patterns for automation (naming conventions, key rotation cadence).
- Org policy controls: passwordless allowed? MFA enforcement? session timeouts and idle logout.
- Audit logs retention for 2 years and export options (S3 or SIEM integration).

Can you propose a minimal implementation checklist and owners to get us through the pilot? We target provisioning and SSO cutover by July 30.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Director, IT Security | GreenWave AI

Attachments: greenwave-access-requirements-2026.pdf (referenced)

Hi Emily — great to hear. Looping in our implementation lead and CS owner. Quick proposal below and an attached checklist to drive the tasks.

High-level implementation plan (pilot scope):
1) SSO + IdP setup (Okta) — target: staging SAML exchange by Jul 20. Owner: Dev Patel.
2) SCIM basics (users + groups) — target: initial SCIM mapping by Jul 23. Owner: Dev Patel.
3) IP allowlist — provide CIDRs, we apply at tenancy level; validate in staging. Owner: Laura Bennett.
4) Service accounts & naming policy — draft conventions + rotation schedule. Owner: Marissa Cole.
5) Org policy defaults (MFA enforced, session timeout 12h, idle logout 30m) — discuss exceptions. Owner: Rishi Malhotra for compliance review.
6) Audit/export — enable 2-year retention + S3 export to your bucket; we'll provide instructions for SIEM integration. Owner: Laura Bennett.

Deliverables attached: redwood-onboard-access-controls-checklist.xlsx (task owners, due dates, and required artifacts). Can you confirm Okta admin email for the SAML exchange and the preferred S3 bucket name for logs export?

Next steps: Emily confirms Okta admin + S3 info; Dev will send SAML metadata and SCIM attribute map. Marissa will share service account naming draft. Rishi will review retention/controls and note any exceptions.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-onboard-access-controls-checklist.xlsx

Emily — thanks. A few technical notes and what we'll need from you to get the staging cutover: 

What redwood will provide:
- SAML service provider metadata (attached stub) and ACS/assertion endpoints.
- SCIM v2 endpoint and suggested attribute map (attached CSV).
- Admin console IP allowlist support per tenancy; we will restrict administrative routes first.
- Service account JWT-based keys (rotated via our API) and role bindings.

What we need from GreenWave:
- Okta admin email and Okta org URL.
- SCIM mappings for group->role if you want automatic role assignment; else we can map by LDAP group name.
- CIDR list for allowlist and any VPN exit nodes to include.
- Desired service account TTL & rotation window (default 90 days).

Notes on SCIM: we support provisioning of users and groups, but not nested groups. If you rely on nested groups, we'll need an explicit mapping. For role-based access we recommend a SCIM group -> Redwood role mapping CSV to be filled out (see attached scim-attribute-map.csv).

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (stub), scim-attribute-map.csv

-Dev

Thanks for the plan — reviewed and a few compliance asks before we apply defaults to a production pilot: 

1) Retention: 2 years is OK, but we should offer a configurable retention window and document export to customer's S3 for legal holds. Add that to the checklist.
2) Service accounts: 90-day rotation is minimum; recommend 60-day rotation for high-privilege automation and require MFA-bound or key-protected flows where possible. Provide a naming convention: svc-greenwave-<env>-<purpose>-<sequential>.
3) IP allowlist: require a secondary verification step if adding a CIDR wider than /24 (risk review).
4) SAML/SCIM: confirm Okta is configured to sign assertions with SHA-256 and that SCIM uses TLS 1.2+. Request Okta metadata file and a contact email for SAML test window.

I'll mark RVP compliance signoff as conditional on the above items. Documented exceptions should go through our Exceptions board (link: https://compliance.redwood.com/exceptions).

Once Emily confirms Okta admin and CIDRs we can schedule the staging exchange.

—Rishi
